Battlezone - Rise of the Black Dogs.name: Battlezone: Rise of the Black Dogs
Battlezone - Rise of the Black Dogs.summary: Battlezone: Rise of the Black Dogs is a port of the PC game Battlezone with extra missions.

Mega Man 64.name: Mega Man 64
Mega Man 64.summary: Mega Man Volnutt is the game's playable character. Mega Man Volnutt is a "Digger", a person in charge of investigating ruins from a flooded Earth. During his journey with his friends, their ship crashes in Kattelox Island, where Mega Man decides to confront pirates who are attacking it to obtain the its hidden treasure. As an action roleplaying game, Mega Man Legends's gameplay is very different from the ones of the original series despite sharing a few elements.
